summary: CORE-TRACE-DEBUGGING: semantic_unresolved -> Add to the plan: The evidence does not explicitly state that this procedure is distinct from anticipated failure modes, and it does not explicitly separate review completeness from the run verdict; it only says a complete review is distinct from a passing run.
